The repository registers 16 `http.matchers.*` modules outside test files. The subagent's report said 17, but its list has 16 entries. I didn't re-check the code myself.

| Module ID | File |
|---|---|
| `http.matchers.host` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.path` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.path_regexp` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.method` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.query` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.header` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.header_regexp` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.protocol` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.tls` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.not` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.remote_ip` | `modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.client_ip` | `modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.vars` | `modules/caddyhttp/vars.go` |
| `http.matchers.vars_regexp` | `modules/caddyhttp/vars.go` |
| `http.matchers.expression` | `modules/caddyhttp/celmatcher.go` |
| `http.matchers.file` | `modules/caddyhttp/fileserver/matcher.go` |

- **TLS matchers:** `modules/caddytls/matchers.go` registers four matchers (`MatchServerName`, `MatchServerNameRE`, `MatchRemoteIP` and `MatchLocalIP`). None has an `http.matchers.` ID, because they are TLS connection-policy matchers.
- **Not registrations:** Other `http.matchers.` strings in the code are `{http.matchers.file.*}` replacer variables and `caddy.GetModule("http.matchers." + name)` lookups.
